results.title: A Literature Review on Digital Creativity in Higher ...
results.content: Research has revealed the positive impact of ICT and digital environments on creativity: virtual reality has been found to significantly improve the creative design process, especially at the design and planning stages, but also at the testing, review, reflection, and feedback stages [15]; another study showed that students who used virtual reality in their work and study generated more creative designs compared to students who had not used the technology [16]; creative, critical, and problem-solving skills were positively influenced by the use of gamification technology, according to the beliefs of Malaysian trainee teachers [17], a finding also supported by another study on the use of gamified learning to enhance digital skills and creativity among secondary school students in Israel [18]. Regarding the impact of teacher digital creativity on reducing or even eliminating the possible risks of technology overuse or misuse by students, by being digitally creative in their teaching process, teachers direct students’ attention toward useful, effective ways to use ICT tools for studying and working.
